title.zh: 一堆开关是怎么学会算数的
title.en: How a Pile of Switches Learned to Do Arithmetic

desc.zh: 只用一种开或关的开关，逐门搭出逻辑门、加法器、记忆、时钟，直到一台能照程序做乘法的 16 字节小机器；每个电路都在页面里逐门模拟。
desc.en: From one on/off switch, build gates, an adder, memory, a clock and finally a 16-byte machine that multiplies by following a program; every circuit is simulated gate by gate on the page.

desc.zh: 两个开关串联是与、并联是或、常闭是非，真值表由开关是否导通决定。
desc.en: Two switches in series give AND, in parallel give OR, and a normally-closed one gives NOT.

zh: 与门 或门 非门

desc.zh: 非、与、或、异或都能只用与非门拼出，最少分别要 1、2、3、4 个。
desc.en: NOT, AND, OR and XOR can all be built from NAND alone, with at least 1, 2, 3 and 4 gates.

desc.zh: n 个开关有 2ⁿ 种样子，8 个开关表示 0 到 255，255 加 1 绕回 0。
desc.en: n switches have 2ⁿ patterns; 8 of them hold 0 to 255, and 255 + 1 wraps to 0.

desc.zh: 半加器、全加器排成行波进位加法器；进位每多走一列多等约 4 个门延迟，最坏 32 个。
desc.en: Half and full adders chained into a ripple-carry adder; each column of carry adds about 4 gate delays, 32 at worst.

desc.zh: 减法 = 加上取反再加 1，同一个加法器多一根线就会减；越过 127 与 −128 的缝就是溢出。
desc.en: Subtracting is adding the inverted number plus one; crossing the 127/−128 seam is overflow.

zh: 负数在计算机里怎么存

desc.zh: 两个与非门首尾相接就能记住一位；S、R 同时松开时会振荡或随机落到一边。
desc.en: Two cross-coupled NANDs remember a bit; releasing S and R together makes it oscillate or fall either way.

desc.zh: 寄存器加上加法器和时钟就是计数器；时钟周期短于最长路径时会收下错误的值。
desc.en: A register plus an adder and a clock makes a counter; a clock shorter than the longest path latches wrong values.

desc.zh: 控制线挑选答案；比较两个数就是相减再看 Z 和 C 标志。
desc.en: Control lines pick an answer; comparing two numbers is subtracting and reading the Z and C flags.

desc.zh: 一台 16 字节、7 条指令的机器，用重复加法做乘法；指令也只是内存里的数。
desc.en: A 16-byte, 7-instruction machine multiplies by repeated addition; instructions are just numbers in memory.

zh: 取指 译码 执行
en: how a CPU runs a program

desc.zh: 0.1 在二进制里写不完，存进有限的尾数要取整，所以 0.1 + 0.2 得到 0.30000000000000004。
desc.en: 0.1 never ends in binary, so it is rounded into a finite mantissa and 0.1 + 0.2 becomes 0.30000000000000004.

title.zh: 真实处理器：规模而非新原理
title.en: Real Processors: Scale, Not New Principles

desc.zh: 流水线、先行进位、缓存和多核都是同样零件的更多份；附 2038 年问题等可带走的结论。
desc.en: Pipelining, carry-lookahead, caches and many cores are more of the same parts; with takeaways like the year-2038 problem.

zh: CPU 和我们搭的有什么区别
